desc.token: Bot access token used to connect to the platform API.
desc.botToken: Bot token used to send and receive messages.
desc.appToken: App token used for Socket Mode connections.
desc.appId: Unique application ID used for authentication.
desc.appSecret: Application secret used for signing and authentication.
desc.encryptKey: Encryption key used to decrypt callback payloads.
desc.baseUrl: Platform API base URL. Official endpoint is used by default.
desc.proxy: HTTP proxy address for outbound network access.
desc.mentionOnly: Only respond when the bot is explicitly mentioned in group chats.
desc.typingEnabled: Display typing status while the assistant is generating a response.
desc.placeholderEnabled: Enable temporary placeholder messages before the final reply is sent.
desc.streamingEnabled: Allow this channel to display provider streaming output. The current model entry streaming switch must also be enabled.
desc.streamingThrottleSeconds: Minimum interval between intermediate streaming updates. 0 means use the default. Final replies are not throttled.
desc.streamingMinGrowthChars: Minimum text growth before sending another intermediate streaming update. 0 means use the default. Final replies are not throttled.
desc.groupTriggerMentionOnly: In group chats, respond only when the bot is mentioned.
desc.groupTriggerPrefixes: Custom group-chat trigger prefixes. Add items one by one, or paste multiple values at once.
desc.randomReactionEmoji: Compa adds emoji reactions to user messages to confirm receipt. Example: "THUMBSUP", "HEART", "SMILE". Leave empty to use the default "Pin" emoji.
desc.isLark: Use Lark international domain (open.larksuite.com) instead of Feishu domain (open.feishu.cn).
desc.allowFrom: Allowed user or group IDs. Add items one by one, or paste multiple values at once.
desc.allowOrigins: Allowed origin domains. Add items one by one, or paste multiple values at once.
desc.useNative: Whether to use native client mode.
desc.clientId: Client ID used for platform authentication.
desc.welcomeMessage: Welcome message content for new sessions.
desc.allowTokenQuery: Allow token in URL query parameters.
desc.requestCaps: IRC capability list requested on connect.
desc.maxBase64FileSizeMiB: Maximum size in MiB for converting local files to base64 before upload. 0 means unlimited. Applies only to local files, not URL uploads.
desc.mqttAgentId: Unique identifier for this instance, used to build the topic path.
desc.mqttClientId: MQTT client ID. Leave blank to auto-generate.
desc.keepAlive: Keepalive interval in seconds. Defaults to 60.
desc.qos: Message quality of service level: 0 = at most once, 1 = at least once, 2 = exactly once.

mqtt.protocolDesc: Clients send and receive messages using the following topic and payload format.
mqtt.uplinkTextDesc: Natural language instruction from the user (required).
mqtt.downlinkTextDesc: Agent reply text. In streaming mode, concatenate multiple messages in order for the full response.
mqtt.topicPrefixDesc: Topic prefix, matches the configuration above.
mqtt.agentIdDesc: Agent ID, matches the configuration above.
mqtt.clientIdDesc: Client-defined identifier. Recommended: generate a UUID on first launch and persist it so the same device always uses the same ID.
mqtt.secretSet: Already configured. Leave blank to keep unchanged.

config.workspace_hint: Base directory for agent file operations.
config.restrict_workspace_hint: Only allow file operations inside workspace.
config.split_on_marker_hint: Split long messages into short ones like real human chatting.
config.tool_feedback_enabled_hint: Send a short execution note into the current chat before each tool runs.
config.tool_feedback_separate_messages_hint: Keep each tool feedback update as its own chat message instead of reusing a single placeholder/progress message.
config.tool_feedback_max_args_length_hint: Maximum number of characters shown in each tool argument preview. Set to 0 to use the default.
config.exec_enabled_hint: Enable or disable command execution for the app. When disabled, no command requests will run.
config.allow_remote_hint: When enabled, remote sessions or non-local contexts can also run commands. When disabled, command execution stays limited to local safe contexts.
config.enable_deny_patterns_hint: When enabled, the app blocks commands that match its built-in dangerous patterns and the custom command blacklist below.
config.exec_timeout_seconds_hint: Maximum runtime for command requests. Set to 0 to use the default timeout.
config.custom_deny_patterns_hint: Add extra command-blocking rules, one regular expression per line. A command matching any rule here will be blocked.
config.custom_allow_patterns_hint: Add extra command-allow rules, one regular expression per line. A command matching any rule here skips the built-in dangerous patterns; the command blacklist above and other safety limits still apply.
config.pattern_detector_hint: Enter a command to test if it matches any blacklist or whitelist patterns.
config.pattern_detector_input_placeholder: Enter a command to test, e.g., rm -rf /tmp
config.allow_shell_execution_hint: Allow scheduled tasks to run commands by default. When disabled, users must pass command_confirm=true to schedule a command task.
config.cron_exec_timeout_hint: Maximum runtime for scheduled commands. Set to 0 to disable the timeout.
config.max_tokens_hint: Upper token limit per model response.
config.context_window_hint: Model input context capacity in tokens. Leave empty to use the default (4x max tokens).
config.max_tool_iterations_hint: Maximum tool-call loops in a single task.
config.summarize_threshold_hint: Start summarization after this many messages.
config.summarize_token_percent_hint: Used when conversation summary is triggered.
config.turn_profile_hint: Controls what context each request carries. Leave disabled to keep the normal chat behavior.
config.turn_profile_enabled_hint: When enabled, this policy applies to every new turn. When disabled, Compa uses the original context behavior.
config.turn_profile_history_hint: Default includes earlier messages from this session. Off makes the turn behave like a fresh chat and skips saving its result back to history.
config.turn_profile_system_prompt_hint: Default includes Compa identity, workspace, memory, and runtime instructions. Off keeps only system prompts explicitly supplied by the request.
config.turn_profile_skills_hint: Default includes available skills and active skill instructions. Off hides them. Allow List keeps only skill names entered one per line.
config.turn_profile_tools_hint: Default exposes normal tools. Off prevents tool calls. Allow List keeps only tool names entered one per line, such as web_search.
config.session_scope_hint: How chat context is isolated across peers/channels.
config.session_scope_per_channel_peer_desc: Separate context for each user in each channel.
config.session_scope_per_peer_desc: One context per user across channels.
config.session_scope_global_desc: All messages share one global context.
config.heartbeat_interval_hint: Interval in minutes between heartbeat signals.
config.monitor_usb_hint: Watch USB plug/unplug events when devices are enabled.
config.autostart_hint: Start Compa automatically when you log in.

config.launcher_section_hint: Changes here take effect after you restart Compa.

config.lan_access_hint: Allow access from other devices on your local network.
config.allowed_cidrs_hint: Only clients from these CIDR ranges can access the service. One per line or comma-separated. Leave empty to allow all.
config.allow_localhost_bypass_hint: When enabled, localhost requests are allowed even when they do not match the allowed CIDRs. Turn this off when Compa runs behind a proxy on the same computer.
config.trusted_proxy_cidrs_hint: Only proxies from these CIDR ranges may provide client IP information such as X-Forwarded-For. Leave empty to ignore proxy client IP headers.

config.mcp_section_hint: Configure MCP servers without editing config.json manually.

config.mcp_discovery_ttl_hint: How many tool-execution TTL ticks discovered tools remain available after search.

config.mcp_discovery_use_regex_hint: Allow regex-based matching in MCP discovery.
